name: Zombie Sniper 2
summary:
Play as Raven 6, an elite sniper protecting the city from a secure vantage point. Take your time, line up the perfect shot, eliminate the infected, and earn rewards to unlock powerful rifles and equipment.

Complete missions, improve your arsenal, and enjoy a satisfying arcade sniping experience in a post-apocalyptic world where precision is everything.

Aim. Fire. Upgrade. Enjoy.

You will always be safe... but your precision and tactics are real.
